title: IHC-Amplified Fluorescent Frozen Sections
author: Elizabeth Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8rmhv46
materials: blocking buffer (10% normal donkey serum in 1.0%)

steps.title: Create Water Barrier
steps.instruction: Use a PAP Pen to draw a water barrier circle around the tissue sections on the slide and allow to dry for several seconds up to approximately one minute.

steps.title: Initial Rinsing
steps.instruction: Perform sequential rinses of the slides.

substeps.instruction: Rinse with PBS (pH 7.3-7.4): 4 x 5 min each
Rinse with 0.5% BSA + 0.4% Triton X-100 in PBS: 1 x 10 min

steps.title: Block Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Prepare slides for blocking in a humidity box.

substeps.instruction: Remove slides one at a time and carefully wipe around the tissue sections with a clean Kimwipe to dry the slide
Place slides into a black, covered slide incubation box/humidity box
Cover tissue sections with blocking buffer (10% normal donkey serum in 1.0% BSA + 0.4% Triton X-100 + PBS)
Incubate for 1.5-2 hrs at RT
Pour off the blocking buffer

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Apply primary antibody and incubate overnight.

substeps.instruction: Replace blocking buffer with primary antibody solution (antibody of choice diluted in 1.0% BSA + 0.4% Triton X-100 + PBS)
Incubate tissue overnight in the incubation box

steps.title: Post-Primary Rinsing
steps.instruction: Rinse slides following primary antibody incubation.

substeps.instruction: Rinse with PBS: 4 x 5 min
Rinse with 0.5% BSA + 0.4% Triton X-100 + PBS: 1 x 10 min

steps.title: Secondary Blocking
steps.instruction: Perform a second blocking step in a humidity box.

substeps.instruction: Place slides into a black, covered slide incubation box/humidity box
Cover tissue sections with blocking buffer (10% normal donkey serum in 1.0% BSA + 0.4% Triton X-100 + PBS)
Incubate for 1.5-2 hrs at RT

steps.title: Fluorescent Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Apply fluorescent secondary antibody and incubate under low light.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fluorescent secondary antibody diluted in 1.0% BSA + 0.4% Triton X-100 + PBS
Cover tissue with the secondary antibody solution and incubate for 2 hrs at RT in the incubation box
Ensure use of low light or cover tissues from this point forward

steps.title: Post-Secondary Rinsing
steps.instruction: Rinse slides after secondary antibody incubation.

substeps.instruction: Rinse with PBS: 4 x 5 min
Remove excess PBS with a Kimwipe

steps.title: Mounting and Sealing
steps.instruction: Mount the tissue sections and seal the slides.

substeps.instruction: Add a drop of mounting medium to the center of the tissue and apply cover glass
Seal cover glass with clear nail polish (add a weight before sealing for thicker tissue)

steps.title: Streptavidin Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform fluorescent Streptavidin secondary antibody incubation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fluorescent Streptavidin secondary antibody diluted in 1.0% BSA + 0.4% Triton X-100 + PBS
Cover tissue with the fluorescent Streptavidin antibody solution and incubate for 2 hrs at RT in the incubation box
Rinse slides with PBS: 4 x 5 min
Remove excess PBS with a Kimwipe
